decisions.reason: GA4 remains the relevant analytics standard for online shops, and this plugin is a close fit with the firm's e-commerce analytics business while being relatively cheap to continue.

The retail system interface plugin still has strategic option value because it can strengthen integrations and client lock-in, but its more specialized demand and maintenance needs keep withdrawal risk noticeable.
SEO support for shop relaunches is tightly embedded in the firm's core full-service offering and can be continued with little additional commitment.
SEO workshops are an adjacent, low-cost way to monetize expertise and generate leads, so management would usually keep testing them while demand becomes clearer.
